title: Backend Web Developer
achievements: Streamlined the development environment using Docker and Kubernetes orchestration, reducing new developer onboarding overhead by ~75% (4 weeks to 1 week).

Resolved critical connection timeouts by optimizing MongoDB configurations (pooling and indexing strategies) on DigitalOcean droplets.
Developed reusable React.js components and integrated a hidden Keystone CMS interface for secure content modification.
Key Achievement: Served as Backend Lead, introducing Agile/Scrum methodologies via Jira, which fast-tracked the deliverable timeline by 3 weeks.
